up: Provide the first 1000 activity rows that are IC50 type with exact standard relation '=' and have a non-null pChEMBL value. The target is the human single-protein target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1275221 (Protein arginine N-methyltransferase 6). Only include rows where the target type is SINGLE PROTEIN and organism is Homo sapiens. Return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES of the compound, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type (IC50), and pChEMBL value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID in ascending order. Limit the output to 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
       td.target_type,
       td.tax_id,
       cs.canonical_smiles,
       md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
       a.standard_type,
       a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1275221'
  AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
